'''Ilim Fhernan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the brother of [[Bant'ena Fhernan]], and had a wife and child during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was kidnapped by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] in order to force [[Bant'ena Fhernan|Bant'ena]] to develop a bioweapon for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] (CIS). He was rescued by the Jedi.
